units.source_text: 正月二十日宫中举行内宴。

en.t: On the twentieth day of the first month, an imperial banquet was held in the palace.

units.source_text: 一番纷忙过去之后，薰中纳言满怀愁恨，

en.t: After the first rush of busyness had passed, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was filled with sorrow and resentment,

units.source_text: 无可告语，不堪其苦，且往匂亲王宫中访晤。

en.t: and, having no one to confide in and unable to bear his suffering, he went for the time being to visit Prince Niou at his residence.

units.source_text: 此时暮色苍茫，匂亲王正独坐窗前，沉思怅望。

en.t: By then the dusk had grown dim and hazy, and Prince Niou was sitting alone by the window, lost in melancholy thought.

units.source_text: 有时抚弄鸣筝，欣赏他所心爱的红梅的芳香。

en.t: From time to time he idly touched the resonant koto and savored the fragrance of the red plum blossoms he loved.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言向梅树低处折取一枝，走进室内，那香气异常馥郁。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, broke off a branch from a low part of the plum tree and came inside; its scent was exceptionally rich.

units.source_text: 匂亲王一时兴到，赋诗赠之：

en.t: Prince Niou was suddenly moved by poetic feeling and composed a verse to give him:
